subject: Forecast align: NovaHealth expansion — commit by 18 Jul
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Forecast commit nudge: NovaHealth upgrade (Q3)

Team —

Quick nudge on the NovaHealth expansion: finance needs a firm stance by end of week so we can lock Q3 numbers. Action items I need from CS and AE by EOD 2026-07-18 (PDT):

- Confirm the current pipeline stage in HubSpot and whether this will be marked as Commit or Upside for Q3.
- Confirm the expected booked ARR for the expansion (billing cadence: annual vs monthly).
- Any open legal/procurement blockers and expected PO date.

I attached a blank commit workbook to make the numbers easy to surface — please drop the ARR, start date, and expected PO date into the sheet and reply. If Nova needs an invoice or SOW draft we should note that in the thread.

Thanks — trying to keep the forecast clean for finance ops next week.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: commit_workbook_q3.xlsx (stub)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast commit nudge: NovaHealth upgrade (Q3)

Karthik —

Thanks for the nudge. Quick status from CS:

- Health: Green across usage and escalations; success team has validated the pilot KPIs.
- Legal: Reviewing MOP / SOW; redlines expected but not material (timeline below).
- Procurement: Procurement team engaged; they asked for our updated SOW and an invoice template.

Our working probability today is 70% (based on legal + procurement cadence). If finance needs a hard commit we can push it to Commit but want to avoid overstating until PO is in flight. Tentative dates: PO expected around 2026-07-28; SOW signoff by 2026-07-24.

I attached the CS activation notes and the current MOP draft for legal. Action items from CS:
- Priyom: please confirm pricing line we should include in the invoice (annual vs monthly).
- Marcus: confirm if pricing impact on Q3 recognition changes (if annual vs monthly).

I'll update HubSpot stage to "Legal Review" and add the expected PO date.

—Monica
Monica Patel | Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CS-activation-notes.pdf, nova_mop_draft.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast commit nudge: NovaHealth upgrade (Q3)

Appreciate the update, Monica. Two quick clarifying asks:

1) Can you confirm the committed ARR number we should carry if finance is asked to treat this as a Commit? My current working number from the AE is $215,000 ARR (annual billing).
2) If procurement is pushing an FY-end PO that pays monthly, does that change how finance wants to mark the deal for Q3?

I've attached a pre-filled forecast_commit_template.xlsx — drop the ARR and billing cadence in the "Commit" tab and I'll submit to Lauren for sign-off. Finance reiterated: if we have no PO by 2026-07-18, they will keep the amount as Upside for this quarter.

Thanks —
Karthik

Attachment: forecast_commit_template.xlsx

Karthik/Monica —

Quick note from procurement side: legal should finish redlines by Friday (2026-07-24) and procurement expects to issue a PO the week of 2026-07-27. We will need an invoice and the final SOW to route internally. Can you confirm whether you will issue an annual invoice or if we should expect monthly billing?

Happy to coordinate — looping procurement for visibility.

Regards,

NovaHealth

Date: 2026-07-18T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast commit nudge: NovaHealth upgrade (Q3)

Team —

Thanks for the updates. Per our internal rules, finance will mark DEAL-4729 as Commit at $215,000 ARR for Q3 contingent on PO issuance by 2026-07-28. If the PO is not received by that date we will move the amount back to Upside.

Next steps for tracking:
- Monica/Priyom: please update HubSpot stage to "Commit" and attach the PO when received.
- AE: send final invoice (annual) + SOW to procurement@novahealth.com and copy finance.
- Marcus: confirm revenue recognition impact if procurement elects monthly instead of annual billing.

I've attached a short commit acknowledgement for records. Once we have the PO, finance will confirm booking and publish the adjusted forecast.

Lauren Bishop | Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: commit_acknowledgement.pdf
